roles._scheme: Each CYCLE is drawn @600 (P1-1) or @500 (P1-2..P1-35); 4 cycles give the slab/outer-wall spacing (@150 / @125). Cycles 1&3 carry the long main bars, cycles 2&4 the short corner/inner bars. Counts per 1 m: 3.33 (=1/0.3) in P1-1, 4 (=1/0.25) elsewhere; corner bars 2 per cycle -> 6.67 / 8. Mark scheme A = P1-1..P1-8 (marks below). Scheme B = P1-9..P1-35 (see _schemeB).
roles.T1: Top slab outer (upper-face) main bar, continuous across the top slab and bent down (R=200 outer bend) into the outer face of BOTH side walls (∩ shape), lapping with the B2 legs at mid-wall; CYCLE-1 & 3
roles.T2: Top slab inner (lower-face) main bar, straight, full span between walls; CYCLE-1 & 3
roles.T3: Short top-left outer corner L-bar (1.140 along top-slab upper face + leg down the wall outer face); CYCLE-2 & 4
roles.T4: Short top-right outer corner L-bar (mirror of T3); CYCLE-2 & 4
roles.T5: Top slab inner (lower-face) straight bar, shorter (stops at haunches); CYCLE-2 & 4
roles.B1: Bottom slab inner (upper-face) main bar, straight; CYCLE-1 & 3
roles.B2: Bottom slab outer (lower-face) main bar, continuous and bent up into the outer face of BOTH side walls (∪ shape); CYCLE-1 & 3
roles.B3: Bottom slab inner (upper-face) straight bar; CYCLE-2 & 4
roles.B4: Short bottom-left outer corner L-bar (bottom-slab lower face + leg up the wall outer face); CYCLE-2 & 4
roles.B5: Short bottom-right outer corner L-bar (mirror of B4); CYCLE-2 & 4
roles.W1: Left side wall inner-face vertical bar, straight; CYCLE-1 & 3 (gives wall inner @300/@250)
roles.W2: Right side wall inner-face vertical bar, straight; CYCLE-1 & 3
roles.R1: Top outer-corner bar: short chord across the outer corner bend of T1, bent 135 deg at both ends (a = diagonal, b = 300 legs running along the top-slab and wall outer bars); 2 per cycle, CYCLE-1 & 3
roles.R2: Bottom outer-corner bar, same shape as R1 at the two bottom outer corners; CYCLE-1 & 3
roles.H1: Top haunch diagonal bar: straight bar parallel to the 45 deg haunch chamfer, running from the wall outer bar layer to the top-slab outer bar layer, 135 deg hooks b=100 at both ends; 2 per cycle (count 6.67/8)
roles.H2: Bottom corner diagonal bar: same type as H1 across the two bottom inner corners (bottom corners have no haunch)
roles.D1: Top slab longitudinal distribution bars (both faces), L = 1 m + lap
roles.D2: Bottom slab longitudinal distribution bars (both faces)
roles.D3: Side wall longitudinal (horizontal) distribution bars (both faces, both walls)
roles.S1: Top slab shear tie / stirrup (hat shape: a = through-thickness length, b = 100 hooks)
roles.S2: Bottom slab shear tie (same shape as S1)
roles.S3: Side wall shear tie (same shape as S1)

_schemeB.applies_to: P1-9 .. P1-35 (T6 and B6 appear; verified on CYCLE diagrams of P1-9 and P1-35)
_schemeB.T1: Top slab outer bar, LEFT part: top-slab upper face bent down into the LEFT wall outer face (lapped with T2 in the top slab); CYCLE-1 & 3 (mirrored in CYCLE-3)
_schemeB.T2: Top slab outer bar, RIGHT part, bent down into the RIGHT wall outer face; CYCLE-1 & 3
_schemeB.T3: Top slab inner (lower-face) straight main bar; CYCLE-1 & 3 (role of T2 in scheme A)
_schemeB.T4: Top-left outer corner L-bar; CYCLE-2 & 4 (role of T3 in scheme A)
_schemeB.T5: Top-right outer corner L-bar; CYCLE-2 & 4 (role of T4 in scheme A)
_schemeB.T6: Top slab inner (lower-face) short straight bar; CYCLE-2 & 4 (role of T5 in scheme A)
_schemeB.B1: Bottom slab inner (upper-face) straight main bar; CYCLE-1 & 3 (same as scheme A)
_schemeB.B2: Bottom slab outer bar, LEFT part, bent up into the LEFT wall outer face; CYCLE-1 & 3
_schemeB.B3: Bottom slab outer bar, RIGHT part, bent up into the RIGHT wall outer face; CYCLE-1 & 3
_schemeB.B4: Bottom slab inner (upper-face) straight bar; CYCLE-2 & 4 (role of B3 in scheme A)
_schemeB.others: W1, W2, R1, R2, H1, H2, D1-D3, S1-S3 keep the scheme-A roles. Exception P1-35: only one R bar, labelled R1 (H29) but drawn at the BOTTOM outer corners (R2 role); no top outer-corner R bar.
